research_hypotheses.signal_timing: When an M15 LONG proxy alert occurs while completed-M5 RCI9 is near its upper extreme, an initial pullback may be more likely before continuation. SHORT is evaluated symmetrically with direction-normalized RCI.
research_hypotheses.higher_timeframe_context: At a causal pullback-turn candidate, H1/H4 RCI9 moving in the trade direction may be associated with stronger subsequent continuation.

data_contract.base_source: Existing exact MT5 M1 history used by M8B/M8BX/M8BZ
data_contract.signal_boundary: Original frozen proxy entry_server_open; only derived bars ending at or before this boundary are visible.
data_contract.turn_boundary: M8BZ candidate_entry_time; only derived bars ending at or before this next-M1-open boundary are visible.

analysis_questions: Does signal-time M5 directional RCI9 relate to subsequent initial pullback depth or delay to first causal turn?
Do turn-time H1/H4 direction-normalized RCI9 slopes relate to return/MFE/MAE after the turn?
Does H1+H4 agreement add information beyond local M1 state?
Are any observed relationships robust across XAUUSD/BTCUSD and LONG/SHORT rather than driven by one tiny subgroup?
